sanskrit_verse:
यदधीते यद्यजते यज्जुहोति यदर्चति ।
तस्य षड्भागभाग्राजा सम्यग्भवति रक्षणात् ॥४१॥
transliteration: yad adhīte yad yajate yaj juhoti yad arcati | tasya ṣaḍbhāgabhāg rājā samyag bhavati rakṣaṇāt ||41||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who studies, he who performs yajña, he who offers oblations, he who worships — the King becomes a sixth part sharer in all these acts because of his duty to protect.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from capacity to sustain collective dharma
Causation is established through protective alignment with action
Capacity-based responsibility includes guardianship of spiritual-economic activity
Restoration logic requires proportional participation without domination
Consciousness alignment necessitates recognition of sovereign support structures
executable_legal_axioms: IF citizen engages in Vedic study OR ritual worship OR offering THEN state entitled to one-sixth share as protective due
IF king protects THEN king receives proportional share ELSE share nullified
IF act is performed THEN automatic recognition of royal sixth-share IF protection is ensured
IF no protection occurs THEN no entitlement to share for ruler
IF violation of dharma in collection THEN forfeiture of right and restoration protocol initiated
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating disputes concerning taxation or royal dues derived from religious or scholarly activities, the Supreme Court must affirm that the legitimacy of such claims rests solely upon demonstrable fulfillment of the sovereign’s protective function. The threshold of responsibility lies in verifiable guardianship, not mere assertion of title.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal linkage between spiritual-economic acts and royal entitlement via the pramāṇa of protection. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential unfolding: performance of dharma → need for security → legitimate royal share. Responsibility is proportional to capacity fulfilled; misalignment triggers completion process rather than punitive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Re-establishment of protective infrastructure where lacking
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Sovereign must demonstrate active guardianship to retain entitlement
Capacity Restoration: Ensuring ruler's ability to fulfill protective role before claim validated
Integrity Reintegration: Realignment of economic-spiritual exchange within dharmic framework
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: the King's share arises only when protection is rendered. Thus Dharma is restored, reality remains non-punitive, and consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
